theme.name: Cinematic Carbon & Blood Amber (La Isla Nublar)
theme.description: Dark, cinematic, tactical gaming atmosphere inspired by Fortnite shop depth and high-risk dinosaur survival bounties.

scale.badge: text-[10px] md:text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded

layout_and_grids.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 space-y-8
layout_and_grids.hero_spotlight: w-full grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-stretch
layout_and_grids.fortnite_style_card_aspect: flex flex-col h-full rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md overflow-hidden hover:border-red-500/50 transition-all duration-300 shadow-xl relative

visual_enhancers.wanted_stamp: uppercase tracking-widest border-2 border-red-600/80 text-red-500 bg-red-950/40 px-3 py-1 font-black text-xs transform -rotate-2 rounded shadow-inner

key_elements: Header banner: Wanted Stamp + Bounty ID + Threat Rank Badge (#1 MOST WANTED, AMENAZA ALTA)
Dinosaur Avatar Visual: High-res render of target dino (T-Rex, Deino, Spino, Carno) with species badge & growth stage progress bar (e.g., 'Adult • 100% Growth')
Target Player Info: Player Name, Steam/Server ID, Last Known Location/Region (e.g., 'Spiro Jungle / Swamp')
Bounty Pool Breakdown: Dual currency display - Total Amberium (💎 Gold) + PrimeMeat (🥩 Green)
Crowdfund/Funders Indicator: Number of contractors who contributed (e.g., '👥 6 Contratistas')
Countdown Timer: Expiration timer with pulsating warning under 1 hour
Action Button: 'RECLAMAR CACERÍA' / 'APOYAR BOUNTY' with amber glow on hover
Header banner: GOLDEN TARGET STAMP + Live Earnings Counter
Dinosaur Avatar Visual: Target player's active dinosaur render with Golden Aura filter
Bounty Reward for Killer: 'Recompensa para el cazador: 2,500 Amberium'
Timer survived: 'Tiempo Sobrevivido: 48m / 60m' with active animated progress bar
Live Telemetry Status: '📍 Coordenadas Transmitidas en Vivo'

accessibility.contrast: APCA high contrast dark mode compliance. Text on overlays backed by solid/glass dark panels.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Honor prefers-reduced-motion CSS query by disabling framer-motion layout transforms.

testing_conventions.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements and data fields must carry data-testid in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace the plain/sparse bounty cards with the new information-rich Fortnite-style visual architecture specified here.
2. Ensure both Contract Bounty and Self Bounty cards have distinct headers, badges, and metric displays.
3. Display dinosaur render images from /renders/{dino}.png alongside dino species name, growth stage progress bar, and server region location.
4. Highlight currency values using /coins/amber.png and /coins/meat.png icons with bold typography.
5. Ensure the sidebar 'Objetivos en Línea' has clear row cards with 'Cazar' action buttons that open the Contract Modal with pre-selected target.
6. Include Framer Motion staggered entrance and lift micro-interactions on hover.
7. Include all specified data-testid attributes across cards, lists, tabs, and action buttons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
